patient_read.label: See patients
patient_read.description: The patient list and records: chart, plans, files and medical history.

patient_write.label: Add and edit patients
patient_write.description: Create, edit, merge and archive patient records and contacts.

visit_read.label: See own visits
visit_read.description: Visits where they are the dentist or that they started.

visit_read_all.label: See all clinic visits
visit_read_all.description: Every visit in the clinic, other dentists' included.

visit_start.label: Start visits
visit_start.description: Start a visit for a dentist when the patient is in the room, without working in it.

visit_amend.label: Correct finished visits
visit_amend.description: Correct a completed visit’s services, prices and times.

visit_void.label: Void visits
visit_void.description: Cancel a completed visit and reverse its charge.

chart_write.label: Chart on the patient record
chart_write.description: Record diagnoses, plans and tooth status outside a visit, and confirm the medical history.

payment_read.label: See patient balances & payments
payment_read.description: One patient's balance, payments, receipts and statements, and the checkout queue.

payment_write.label: Record payments
payment_write.description: Take payments and advances, record opening balances and release advances.

payment_refund.label: Refund and adjust
payment_refund.description: Refund and void payments, and adjust a balance.

finance_read.label: See clinic finances
finance_read.description: The Payments screen, receivables, unpaid visits, balances in lists and every export with money.

visit_discount.label: Apply discounts
visit_discount.description: Discount a visit or a line, change a line's price, and discount at checkout.

catalog_read.label: See the catalog
catalog_read.description: Services and diagnoses, with their prices.

catalog_write.label: Edit the catalog
catalog_write.description: Add and change services, diagnoses, prices and the medical-history lists.

file_read.label: See images and documents
file_read.description: A patient's X-rays, photos and documents.

file_write.label: Upload and edit files
file_write.description: Add images and documents and edit their details.

file_archive.label: Archive files
file_archive.description: Take a file out of the patient record.

user_read.label: See staff
user_read.description: Staff names, for the dentist pickers.

user_write.label: Manage staff
user_write.description: Add staff, edit their profiles, deactivate them and reset passwords.

role_read.label: See roles and access
role_read.description: What each role and each person can do.

role_write.label: Manage roles and access
role_write.description: Edit roles, create custom ones and give people extra permissions.

compensation_read.label: See own compensation
compensation_read.description: Reserved for dentist compensation, coming soon.

compensation_manage.label: Manage compensation
compensation_manage.description: Reserved for compensation agreements and payouts, coming soon.

expense_read.label: See expenses
expense_read.description: The expense history, its totals and export, the Today card and the fixed expenses waiting for confirmation.

expense_manage.label: Manage expenses
expense_manage.description: Record, edit and void expenses; manage categories and fixed expenses; confirm and skip what is waiting.

payroll_read.label: See payroll
payroll_read.description: Employees and their salaries, the payroll runs and history, and salary rows in Expenses.

payroll_manage.label: Manage payroll
payroll_manage.description: Add and edit employees, change salaries, adjust, confirm, skip and void payroll lines.

lab_read.label: See lab orders
lab_read.description: Lab orders and their status labels, the Lab work lane on Today, the lab directory without prices, and the lab reports without costs.

lab_manage.label: Manage lab orders
lab_manage.description: Create and edit lab orders, attach files, mark them sent, received and done, hold, cancel, send back, ask for a remake, link the appointment and print the slip.

lab_money_read.label: See lab money
lab_money_read.description: Lab price lists, order costs, lab accounts and statements, outstanding amounts and the costs in the lab reports.

lab_money_manage.label: Manage lab money
lab_money_manage.description: Register and edit labs, their services and prices; edit order costs; record opening balances, adjustments, payments and voids.

inventory_read.label: See stock
inventory_read.description: Items, quantities, labels, the Today card, the suppliers directory, the reorder list and reports without costs.

inventory_write.label: Take out and receive
inventory_write.description: Take stock out and undo it the same day, report a wrong count, receive deliveries without prices and attach the invoice.

inventory_manage.label: Manage inventory
inventory_manage.description: Items and categories, reorder levels, suppliers, adjustments and write-offs, counts, reversals, mark ordered, void a receipt.

inventory_money_read.label: See inventory money
inventory_money_read.description: Costs, stock value, receipt totals and attached invoices, suppliers’ accounts and statements, costs in reports.

inventory_money_manage.label: Manage inventory money
inventory_money_manage.description: Price receipts, one-off purchases, opening balances, payments, adjustments and voids on suppliers’ accounts.

appointment_write.label: Manage own appointments
appointment_write.description: Book, confirm, check in, move and cancel their own appointments.

appointment_write_all.label: Manage every dentist's appointments
appointment_write_all.description: Act on every dentist's appointments, the follow-up list and the waitlist.

appointment_override.label: Book through warnings
appointment_override.description: Book over a dentist's other appointment or outside opening hours.

audit_read.label: See activity
audit_read.description: The clinic's activity log and a visit's history.

tenant_read.label: See clinic settings
tenant_read.description: The clinic's details, branches and rooms.

tenant_write.label: Edit clinic settings
tenant_write.description: Clinic details, branches, rooms and the chart display.

import_run.label: Import data
import_run.description: Bring services, patients and visits in from another system.

dashboard_financial.label: See financial dashboard
dashboard_financial.description: The Financial dashboard: production, collections, costs, what is owed and owing. Includes seeing money across patients.

dashboard_operational.label: See operational dashboard
dashboard_operational.description: The Operational dashboard: counts, rates and times for the whole clinic, whatever the user’s own visits. No money.
